meta.title: JSON을 SQL로 변환하는 변환기 - 무료 온라인 마이그레이션 도구
meta.description: JSON 데이터를 SQL INSERT 문으로 즉시 변환하세요. 데이터베이스 이관을 위한 무료 온라인 도구.
meta.subtitle: JSON 데이터를 데이터베이스용 SQL 쿼리로 즉시 변환

content.hero_title: JSON 데이터를 SQL 쿼리로 자동 변환
content.hero_subtitle: The fastest way to generate database seeding scripts
content.p1: 개발 현장에서 수집된 JSON 데이터를 데이터베이스에 직접 넣고 싶을 때, 수동으로 쿼리를 짤 필요가 없습니다. 당사의 도구는 JSON 배열의 각 객체를 분석하여 해당되는 SQL `INSERT` 구문을 자동으로 생성해 줍니다. MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite 등 주요 DB에서 바로 사용 가능합니다.
content.what_desc: If you have a collection of data in JSON format—such as an export from a NoSQL database or an API response—and you need to insert it into a relational database like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, this tool is for you. It formats each object into a clean SQL statement.

fast.title: Instant Generation
fast.desc: Generate hundreds of SQL lines in the blink of an eye.

private.title: 안전한 변환
private.desc: DB 정보 노출 위험 없이 브라우저 로컬에서 안전하게 변환됩니다.

copy.title: One-Click Export
copy.desc: Copy the entire script or download it for your migrations.

smart.title: Smart Escaping
smart.desc: Automatically handles quotes and special characters in strings.

free.title: 100% Free
free.desc: No limits, no registration, no hassle.

db.title: Cross-DB Friendly
db.desc: Generates standard SQL compatible with most database systems.

migration.title: Data Migration
migration.desc: Easily move data from JSON-based systems to SQL databases.

import.title: Bulk Importing
import.desc: Load large amounts of test or production data quickly.

api.title: API to Database
api.desc: Convert third-party API results directly into SQL inserts.

test.title: Test Data Seeding
test.desc: Create SQL scripts for populating development environments.

backup.title: Backup Restoration
backup.desc: Turn JSON backups back into functional SQL scripts.

dev.title: Rapid Prototyping
dev.desc: Quickly populate new database tables during development.

how_steps: Paste your JSON (must be an array or object)
Click Generate SQL to create the script
Copy the SQL output to your clipboard

faq.a1: The tool works best with an array of objects, where each object represents a database row.
faq.a2: It currently maps top-level keys. Nested objects are usually stringified or skipped depending on your DB needs.
faq.q3: Is there a limit on rows?
faq.a3: There is no hard limit, though your browser's performance may vary with thousands of rows.

tips_list: Ensure your JSON keys match your SQL column names exactly.
Always verify the generated SQL before running it on a production database.
Use the "Example" button to see the expected JSON structure.

js.error_empty: Please enter JSON data and a table name
js.error_no_copy: No SQL to copy. Please convert JSON first.
